changedBehavior: A verified close-first update helper waits for FingVibe to exit, revalidates and runs Setup, records correlated installer/relaunch outcomes, and optionally restarts the verified installation.
expectedAssertions: Only a complete, eligible installed-copy Setup can create a close-first handoff, and changed hash/size/security-marking evidence is refused.
The helper waits for the originating process identity, runs the verified installer, records its exit outcome and verifies the installed version/ownership marker.
Relaunch-disabled mode leaves FingVibe closed; relaunch-enabled mode starts only the verified installed executable.
Failure to prepare or launch the helper remains explicit while FingVibe is open; later installer/relaunch outcomes remain durable for the next launch.
Restart and update remains keyboard reachable and keeps existing download, confirmation, cancellation and portable-copy behavior.
